visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a bustling nighttime street in Seoul with a large, bright digital screen in the background displaying vibrant colors. Three young women are the focus: the host on the left in a pink top, an interviewee in the center wearing a black crop top, and another host on the right in a black top with cut-outs. The interviewee holds a large white Olive Young shopping bag. They look down into the bag with expressions of excitement and curiosity. (2) The camera moves to a close-up as the interviewee pulls out a tube of hand cream. Her hands are steady as she presents the item. The background remains a blur of urban lights and the digital screen. (3) The scene shifts to a second interviewee, a woman with dark hair and a white-and-blue striped jacket. She stands between the two hosts. She reaches into her shopping bag and pulls out a box of facial masks. Her facial expressions are animated as she describes her purchases. (4) A third interviewee appears, wearing a horizontal striped shirt and a beige baseball cap. She shows a pink Unove hair treatment set and a yellow bottle of mist. The hosts react with high-energy gestures, pointing at the products. (5) Three more young women are interviewed together. One holds two colorful shopping bags. They present a clear-cased eye shadow palette with seashell-shaped pans. The environment is lit by bright street lights and the colorful glow of the digital screen behind them. (6) In the final phase, one of the interviewees performs a quick, playful spinning dance move (the 'Wonyoung turn') while the others laugh and cheer, their bodies leaning in with joyful expressions.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy, upbeat electronic pop music characterized by a steady 4/4 drum machine beat and bright synthesizer stabs. Two female voices engage in excited, fast-paced dialogue. A 'pop' sound effect punctuates the start of a new sentence. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers as the speakers change focus. The primary female voice maintains a high pitch and rising intonations, expressing enthusiasm. Background urban ambiance of a busy street is faintly audible under the clean dialogue. (3) As the shopping bag is rummaged through, a distinct plastic rustling sound is heard. A 'ding' SFX coincides with a text overlay appearing. The BGM remains constant in tempo and energy. (4) Another 'whoosh' marks a transition to a new interviewee. The new voice has a similar energetic prosody but a slightly different timbre. Frequent laughter and short exclamations ('Oh!', 'Ah!') are interspersed with the dialogue. (5) Toward the end, the voices culminate in collective laughter and cheering. The BGM reaches a slightly higher intensity before a final hard cut ends the track.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase trending and 'must-buy' beauty and skincare products from the Korean retailer Olive Young by interviewing shoppers on the streets of Seoul, using social proof to influence viewers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Frequent display of Olive Young bags, specific product close-ups with brand names, and enthusiastic positive reviews from interviewees.
